title: Core · Service
description: V2 A12.6.2: one Core service in detail (choose it with "Core service"), LOCAL observability. Provisioned from the repository; edits in the UI are not saved.

list.name: job
list.label: Core service
list.description: The Prometheus scrape job of a Core service (the eight jobs only).

panels.title: Target up
panels.description: Prometheus `up` for the selected job (kit metrics listener, 9464). DOWN: Prometheus could not scrape it. Every other panel on this dashboard is empty while it is down.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: `time() - process_start_time_seconds`: time since the process started. Counters shown "since start" below reset when it restarts.

panels.title: Readiness — last result
panels.description: `nawara_readiness_ready` from the LAST /ready run (1 ready, 0 not ready, including draining), only once a run happened (last-run timestamp > 0). The kit exports 0 before the first run; "not run" means /ready has not been called since start (Compose healthchecks call /health), NOT that the service is unready. Dashboard only: no readiness alert.

panels.title: Readiness — age of last run
panels.description: `time() - nawara_readiness_last_run_timestamp_seconds`, for a run that happened (timestamp > 0). Large: the result is old, not wrong. "not run": /ready has not been called since start.

panels.title: Readiness — checks in last run
panels.description: `nawara_readiness_check_up` per named check in the last /ready run (1 passed, 0 failed), only once a run happened. Shows which dependency failed when the result is NOT READY.

panels.title: Request rate by status class
panels.description: `sum by (status_class) (rate(nawara_http_server_requests_total[5m]))`. Probe routes (/health, /ready, /auth/health) are excluded by the kit. No data: no request since start.

panels.title: 5xx ratio (≥ 1 request/min)
panels.description: Share of 5xx answers over 5 minutes, computed only when the service served at least 1 request per minute in that window; below that it is blank (not applicable), never 0. 0 means traffic with no 5xx.

panels.title: Latency p95 / p99 (histogram estimate)
panels.description: `histogram_quantile` over `nawara_http_server_request_duration_seconds` (buckets 5 ms … 60 s), all routes, 5-minute window. An estimate interpolated inside a bucket: precise only to the bucket bounds. Blank when there was no request in the window (never 0).

panels.title: Busiest routes (5m, top 10)
panels.description: `topk(10, sum by (method, route) (rate(nawara_http_server_requests_total[5m])))`. `route` is the matched route TEMPLATE (bounded by the routes the service declares; `__unmatched__` for no route), never the raw path.

panels.title: Routes answering 5xx (5m)
panels.description: Routes with a 5xx rate above 0 over 5 minutes. Empty ("no 5xx"): no route answered 5xx in the window, including when there was no traffic at all (see the request rate).

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: `nawara_http_server_requests_in_flight`: requests being handled now, probes included. Sustained > 0 without traffic suggests stuck requests.

panels.title: Pool clients
panels.description: `nawara_db_pool_*` per pool: open (in use + idle), idle, waiting (requests queued for a client) and the configured maximum (DB_POOL_MAX). Sustained waiting > 0 is saturation. No data: the service has no database pool (not applicable).

panels.title: Pool in use / max
panels.description: (open − idle) / max per pool: the share of the pool maximum checked out right now. No data: no pool (not applicable).

panels.title: Pool errors (since start)
panels.description: `nawara_db_pool_errors_total` by pool and bounded failure kind (idle-client errors), since the process started. "none observed": no error since start, or no pool.

panels.title: Outbox pending and retrying
panels.description: `nawara_outbox_pending_events` and `nawara_outbox_retrying_events` (the `nawara-check-outbox-lag` aggregate), shown only once the relay has read it (stats timestamp > 0): before the first read the kit exports 0, which is not a real zero. No data: the service has no outbox (audit-service, notification-service: not applicable) or the aggregate has not been read yet.

panels.title: Oldest pending age
panels.description: `nawara_outbox_oldest_pending_age_seconds` (0 when nothing is pending), once the aggregate has been read. No data: no outbox (not applicable) or not read yet.

panels.title: Outbox stats age
panels.description: `time() - nawara_outbox_stats_timestamp_seconds`: how old the outbox figures are. The relay re-reads them at most every 15 s while it polls; a growing age means the read is failing or the relay stopped, so the figures to the left are stale. No data: no outbox (not applicable) or not read yet.

panels.title: Relay pass failures (since start)
panels.description: `nawara_outbox_relay_pass_failures_total` by bounded failure kind, since the process started. "none observed": no failed pass since start, or no outbox.

panels.title: Consumers attached
panels.description: `nawara_event_consumer_up` per queue this service consumes: 1 consuming, 0 lost or closed. No data: the service consumes nothing (not applicable), never a failure.

panels.title: Consumer incidents (since start)
panels.description: Per queue, since the process started: consumer losses and recoveries, broker redeliveries, and acknowledgements that could not be sent (settle failures; the broker redelivers those, so a delivery can count as processed AND as a settle failure). Each line appears once it first happened: "none observed" means none since start, or the service consumes nothing.

panels.title: Publish outcomes (since start)
panels.description: `nawara_events_published_total` by outcome (confirmed, failed, confirm_timeout), since the process started. An outcome appears once it first happened: "none observed" means this service has not published since start (or does not publish).

panels.title: Consumed by outcome
panels.description: `sum by (queue, outcome) (rate(nawara_events_consumed_total[5m]))`. processed = the handler completed; retry_scheduled; dead_lettered_* = parked in `<queue>.dead` by the application; dead_letter_deferred = the dead-letter copy could not be confirmed, requeued. An outcome appears once it first happened (not yet observed before). No data: nothing consumed since start, or no consumer.

panels.title: Handler duration p95 (histogram estimate)
panels.description: `histogram_quantile(0.95, …nawara_event_handler_duration_seconds…)` per queue over 5 minutes (buckets 5 ms … 60 s; precise only to the bucket bounds). Blank when the queue handled nothing in the window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (queue, le) (rate(nawara_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job"}[5m]))) and on (queue) (sum by (queue) (rate(nawara_event_handler_duration_seconds_count{job="$job"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: `rate(process_cpu_seconds_total[5m])`: CPU seconds used per second (1 = one full core).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size and the V8 heap (used, total).

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: `nodejs_eventloop_lag_p99_seconds` and `_max_seconds` (sampled between scrapes). Sustained high lag: the process is CPU-bound or blocked.

panels.title: GC time share
panels.description: `sum by (kind) (rate(nodejs_gc_duration_seconds_sum[5m]))`: fraction of wall time spent in garbage-collection pauses, by GC kind.
